Descubrimos y promocionamos los atractivos de nuestra comunidad.

definitions.instrument: Row in evaluation_instruments; a revision may create another row.
definitions.snapshot: Immutable row in evaluation_instrument_snapshots, one per instrumentId; versionNo/previousSnapshotId describe lineage.
definitions.otherSnapshot: Not the current snapshot of an API-visible activity; may be a predecessor, refer to another/inactive activity, or be unreferenced. This does not imply loss.
definitions.revisionRows: Subset of all snapshot rows with previousSnapshotId; not additive to snapshotRows.
